verdict.rationale: Kintsugi's marketing docs claim it 'finds the exposure you didn't know you had, registers you, and files everywhere you sell' and its nexus engine looks back across a full calendar year to detect when a filing obligation began, which gestures at a remediation path, but there is no explicit mention of voluntary disclosure agreements (VDAs) or structured back-filing of prior-period tax returns to limit look-back liability. Missing for 10: explicit VDA program/process, documentation of back-filing past-due returns, any guidance on negotiating reduced look-back exposure with states.
